examples.quote: Users should be able to stabilize separation and weakly estimated coefficients while seeing exactly which coefficients receive a penalty. The expert check starts from the data likelihood and final design matrices, not optimizer convergence alone. Exact Gaussian ridge solutions, direct binomial likelihood calculations, finite-difference derivatives and matched glmmTMB examples provide external numerical checks. R and Julia agreeing with each other is an additional check, never the only oracle.
